17   Senator Little, why do you rise?

18                SENATOR LITTLE:   Thank you, 

19   Mr. President.  If I could explain my vote, 

20   please.

21                ACTING PRESIDENT MARCELLINO:    

22   Senator Little to explain her vote.

23                SENATOR LITTLE:   Thank you.  

24                I'd like to explain that this 

25   bill does not apply to the State Forest 

                                                                559

 1   Preserve lands that are held within the 

 2   Adirondack Park and the Catskill Park because 

 3   you cannot timber land on the Forest 

 4   Preserve.  

 5                What this applies to is the 

 6   Forest Preserve lands, the state lands that 

 7   are timbered, so that they no longer have to 

 8   go through an approval process with the 

 9   Comptroller, but only through the DEC, who has 

10   oversight over the timbering of those state 

11   lands which are managed and timbered.  And it 

12   streamlines the process so that you do not 

13   have to have the approval of the Comptroller 

14   until you get to that price level of $50,000.

15                The price has not been changed 

16   since 1999, and the value of timber has 

17   increased since 1999.  So while it may be the 

18   same amount of timber, you are way over the 

19   $10,000 mark, you then have to have the 

20   approval of the DEC and the Comptroller.  This 

21   would eliminate the Comptroller from approval 

22   until you get to $50,000.  

23                So last year the vote on this 

24   bill was 62 to zero.  And I thank all those 

25   who voted for it last year, and I hope you 

                                                                560

 1   would do so again this year.

 2                But thank you.  I vote aye.

 3                ACTING PRESIDENT MARCELLINO:
